sections.Profile:
The "Hong Kong" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in September 1952, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Travel, Women, Wood Rail, City, Original Theme, Adventure
